title.narrative: Expanding an integrated and comprehensive approach to Malaria control in the Democratic Republic of Timor-Leste - Timor-Leste (01-Jan-2015-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Timor-Leste, Malaria, Ministry of Health of the Democratic Republic of Timor-Leste (MOH)This program has the following goals: To reduce the incidence of malaria related morbidity and mortality in DRTL in 2012 by 30% by the year 2017, and to provide further reduction by an additional 20% by the year 2020. The objectives of this program are: To build in-country capacity in malaria prevention and control, and in operations management (objective 7). To conduct operations and implementation research to provide evidence to facilitate malaria prevention and control activities cost effectively (objective 6). To ensure that vulnerable populations are adequately protected against malaria (objective 5). To reduce the incidence of malaria in children under 5 in 2012 by 30% by the year 2017, and to provide a further reduction by an additional 20% by the year 2020 (objective 2). To reduce the incidence of malaria in DRTL in 2012 by 30% by the year 2017, and to provide a further reduction by an additional 20% by the year 2020. (objective 1). To reduce the level of malaria related mortality in DRTL in 2012 by 25% by the year 2017, and to reduce it by a further 25% by the year 2020. (objective 3). To strengthen parasitological and entomological surveillance to forecast, detect and control outbreaks (objective 4)
